title: Correct tension in OB
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (1) must give the tension in string OB as 3 N.

title: Correct tension in OA
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (1) must give the tension in string OA as 3√2 N.

title: Maximum weight calculation
description: Essential: The student's answer for part (2) must give the maximum gravitational force as 6 N.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: The solution must correctly resolve forces at point O, establishing equilibrium in horizontal and vertical directions.

title: Limiting condition analysis
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must identify that OB reaches its maximum tension (6 N) before OA does.

title: Trigonometric application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply trigonometric functions (tan 45°, sin 45°) to relate the tensions and the weight.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All final numerical answers should be presented with the correct unit (N).

title: Incorrect limiting string
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution incorrectly assumes string OA (with a 10 N limit) breaks first, leading to a wrong maximum weight.

title: Trigonometric error
description: Pitfall: Penalize sign errors or misuse of sin/cos/tan when relating the weight and tensions.
